en: Vintage green-tinted street-and-square view showing arcaded houses with shop awnings, pedestrians in early 20th‑century dress, gas lamps, and a domed church tower at the edge of a large cobbled square backed by a wooded hill. Printed caption at top reads "Brassó — Kronstadt / Búzasor — Kornzeile." The reverse is a Hungarian "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP" with a BRASSÓ postmark and a handwritten message and address to Budapest.
